IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_blockybrown: A cuboid alpaca: same animal, same pack load, same herding, same voice - but assembled from boxes. Geometry is entirely script-generated (23 boxes bound rigidly to the base skeleton), so nothing here is copied from another game.\nSame species as the regular alpaca: they breed together and share the fleece moodle.\nHerbivore, suffers above 24 C, at home below 4 C. Carries more than twice a dog's load.
